rows.label: Mode
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: Light or dark.

rows.label: Grey
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: The grey the whole interface is built from.

rows.label: Light tint hue
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: The hue of the grays in light, and in dark unless dark has its own: Auto follows Neutral, Accent the accent's hue, or any hue, every degree.

rows.label: Dark tint hue
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: The hue of the grays in dark: Same as light, Auto (Neutral's), Accent, or any hue, every degree.

rows.label: Light grey tint
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: In light: how strongly the grays take the tint's hue. Auto follows Neutral; 0 (None) to 100.

rows.label: Dark grey tint
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: In dark: how strongly the grays take the tint's hue. Auto follows Neutral; 0 (None) to 100.

rows.label: Text tint
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: How much of the tint body and muted text take, 0 (None) to 100 (Full).

rows.label: Accent
rows.heading: Accent
rows.description: The accent color: one of the palette's eleven, or any hue in 5° steps. Drives selection, focus and accent actions.

rows.label: Saturation
rows.heading: Accent
rows.description: How much of its own color the accent keeps, 100 (the palette) to 30 (dusty). Hue and contrast hold.

rows.label: Light shade
rows.heading: Accent
rows.description: In light: the accent step solid fills (accent buttons, checked marks) sit on. Auto, or 200 (lightest) to 850 (deepest); the label turns black or white to stay readable.

rows.label: Dark shade
rows.heading: Accent
rows.description: In dark: the accent step solid fills (accent buttons, checked marks) sit on. Auto, or 200 (lightest) to 850 (deepest); the label turns black or white to stay readable.

rows.label: Label tint
rows.heading: Accent
rows.description: How much of the accent's own hue the label on an accent button takes, 0 (None) to 100 (Full); every position stays readable.

rows.label: Status
rows.heading: Emphasis
rows.description: Danger, warning, success and info as the palette draws them, or quieted to the Accent strength. Their hues never move.

rows.label: Tone contrast
rows.heading: Emphasis
rows.description: The lowest contrast colored status words keep on their tints: 4.5 (AA) by default, down to 2.5 for brighter, more saturated tones. Links, body text and edges keep theirs.

rows.label: Tone tint
rows.heading: Emphasis
rows.description: How much color status and label tints carry, as a percent of Area's: 0 is the gray fill, 160 the richest. Their words stay at Tone contrast.

rows.label: Series lightness
rows.heading: Emphasis
rows.description: How deep the data colors sit on their palette families, as sky's step: 350 (the lightest) or 400. Every series moves the same number of steps.

rows.label: Buttons
rows.heading: Emphasis
rows.description: The color of what you press to commit: solid Buttons, Split button, send.

rows.label: Selection
rows.heading: Emphasis
rows.description: The color of state: checked, on, selected, current and filled values, selected edges and the focus ring.

rows.label: Light page lightness
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: The light page's lightness, 100 (white) to 90.

rows.label: Dark page lightness
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: The dark page's lightness, 0 (black) to 24.

rows.label: Light layer contrast
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: In light: how far cards, menus and sidebars sit from the page, and controls from their ground, 0 (Flat) to 100.

rows.label: Dark layer contrast
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: In dark: how far cards, menus and sidebars sit from the page, and controls from their ground, 0 (Flat) to 100.

rows.label: Light card shade
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: In light: cards and asset cards against the page. Auto keeps each one's own tone; −100 (darker) to +100 (lighter), 0 matches the page.

rows.label: Dark card shade
rows.heading: Page
rows.description: In dark: cards and asset cards against the page. Auto keeps each one's own tone; −100 (darker) to +100 (lighter), 0 matches the page.

rows.label: Type size
rows.heading: Size
rows.description: The base interface text size, 12 to 16; every type role, mark and icon follows it.

rows.label: Density
rows.heading: Size
rows.description: The room around text, as the medium Button's height at type 14: 28 (Compact), 32 or 36 (Comfortable). Heights, gaps and insets follow it and the type size.

rows.label: Corner
rows.heading: Shape
rows.description: One corner setting, from Sharp to Pill: controls scale with their height, surfaces and nested shapes follow.

rows.label: Stroke width
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The line round cards, panels and floating surfaces, in px: 0 (flat, no line) to 2, or Hairline (one device pixel).

rows.label: Edge shadow
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: A subtle shadow round cards, panels and floating surfaces at rest, 0 (none) to 8, with the line or instead of it.

rows.label: Floating shadow
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: How much menus, popovers, tooltips and dialogs lift, as the Menu's shadow strength from 0 (flat) to 8.

rows.label: Edge contrast
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: How dark every stroke is: its distance from its ground, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps

rows.label: Resting shadow
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: How much cards and panels lift at rest, 0 (none) to 8: one small contact layer, 3 is 4%

rows.label: Hover lift
rows.heading: States
rows.description: How much a hovered card or tile lifts, 0 (none) to 8: one tight layer, 3 is 8% (ChatGPT's md)

rows.label: Field shadow
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: How much fields, select triggers, outline and soft buttons lift, 0 (none) to 8, in % as Shadow

rows.label: Shadow reach
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: How far every shadow reaches, its offset and blur, 0 (touching) to 8

rows.label: Shadow softness
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: How each shadow is drawn: one crisp layer (0) to six eased layers held under the surface (8)

rows.label: Shadow light
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: Light from the top: a line under each lifted edge and a highlight inside its top, 0 (flat) to 4

rows.label: Shadow color
rows.heading: Shadow
rows.description: The light theme's shadow color; dark shadows stay black

rows.label: Cards stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The frame round cards, asset cards, file tiles, attachments, board cards and surfaces, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Blocks stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The frame round code blocks, tables and preview frames in a page, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Callouts stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The frame round an alert or notice in the flow, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Floating stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The rim of menus, popovers, hover cards, toasts, dialogs, drawers and pickers, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Regions stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The seams between panels and the app's regions, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Dividers stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The rules between rows and sections: separators, table, list and accordion rows, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Fields stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The edge of soft fields: inputs, selects, number fields, text areas, pickers, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Buttons stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The edge of soft buttons, button groups, toggle groups and the Segmented track, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Options stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The edge of soft choice rows and choice cards, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Tracks stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The edge of slider, switch, progress and meter troughs, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Tags stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: The edge of soft badges, counts, tags and keys, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Media stroke
rows.heading: Stroke
rows.description: A hairline round avatars, swatches and pictures, 0 (none) to 8 in half steps: each step 2.5% of the text color

rows.label: Focus ring
rows.heading: States
rows.description: Where the keyboard focus ring sits: hugging controls, off them, inside them, as a field halo, or bold.

rows.label: Hover edge
rows.heading: States
rows.description: How far a control's edge darkens under the pointer: 0 (it stays) to 4.

rows.label: Selected edge
rows.heading: States
rows.description: How wide a selected card's or tile's edge is, drawn inside it: 1, 2 or 3px.

rows.label: Selected tint
rows.heading: States
rows.description: Whether a selected card or tile also fills: none, the accent's tint, or a neutral wash.

rows.label: Hover fill
rows.heading: States
rows.description: How dark the plate under a hovered row or ghost control is, 25 (faintest) to 100.

rows.label: Selected fill
rows.heading: States
rows.description: How much firmer a selected row's plate is than hover, 0 (the same) to 100.

rows.label: Pressed fill
rows.heading: States
rows.description: How much firmer the plate is while pressed, 25 to 100: the share of the way from selected to the firmest press.

rows.label: Danger hover
rows.heading: States
rows.description: A destructive row's hover plate: tinted red, or the same grey as every other row.

rows.label: Speed
rows.heading: Effects
rows.description: How long transitions take, as the Menu's open in ms from 0 (none) to 300, 210 by default; every duration scales from it.

rows.label: Easing
rows.heading: Effects
rows.description: The shape of every transition: Subtle, Standard, Snappy, Gentle or Spring. Motion sets how long; this sets how.

rows.label: Feedback
rows.heading: Effects
rows.description: How a control answers the pointer: Off, Subtle or Pronounced. Speed sets how long; this sets how much moves.

scoped.label: Contrast
scoped.description: How strong edges, focus and state are: System follows the OS; 0 (Standard) to 8 (More) strengthen them, 8 to 3:1.

scoped.label: Pills
scoped.description: Which components draw a pill instead of the Radius corner.
